root_idea.summary: A lexically heterogeneous root with branches involving fire emerging from a firebrand, concealment or covering, and the far side of a reference point; the recorded words do not form a single uniform semantic class.
root_idea.development: The evidence preserves meanings of fire emerging and bodily interior disease alongside causative fire-making, concealment, reciprocal or reflexive hiding, and the relational noun وَرَاءَ for what is behind or on the far side. وَرَاءَ also extends to what is beyond or after a reference point, while several independent nominal and idiomatic branches remain distinct.

senses.definition: To hide, conceal, or cover something from view.
senses.usage_conditions: A transitive Form III use; the Quranic group includes active forms meaning to hide or cover and a passive form meaning to be concealed.

senses.definition: To make a firebrand produce fire; to ignite or kindle fire.
senses.usage_conditions: A causative fire-making use, especially of causing the fire of a zend or firebrand to issue.

senses.definition: To hide oneself, become concealed, or withdraw from sight.
senses.usage_conditions: An intransitive or reflexive concealment use; the subject becomes hidden rather than concealing an external object.

senses.definition: Producing sparks or causing fire to issue.
senses.usage_conditions: An active participle describing something that produces sparks or brings forth fire; no particular object class is required by the lexical evidence.

senses.definition: Behind, on the far side of, or beyond a reference point in space.
senses.usage_conditions: A relational noun or locative expression whose orientation depends on the reference point; what is on the other side may be translated as behind, ahead, or on the far side, including across a covering or barrier.

senses.definition: Beyond, after, or outside a stated limit, object, or entitlement.
senses.usage_conditions: Used figuratively or temporally for what lies beyond something, what follows it, or what exceeds a prescribed scope.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To produce fire; for a firebrand or zend, to have its fire issue.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An intransitive Form I use with the firebrand as subject.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To conceal the intended matter by presenting another; to equivocate, allude ambiguously, or use an expression whose apparent meaning differs from the intended one.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Includes the constructions وَرَّى بِشَىْءٍ عَنْ شَىْءٍ and وَرَّى عَنْ كَذَا, as well as the verbal noun تَوْرِيَةٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Purulent matter within the body; an abscess or severe ulcer discharging pus and blood.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A medical or bodily nominal use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A thing lying behind one as though it were a burden carried on one's back.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An idiomatic expression describing an encumbering matter that is behind or upon one.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An aider or follower of someone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: In the construction فُلَانٌ مِنْ وَرَاءِ فُلَانٍ, the expression denotes support or following rather than simple location.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To pursue, watch, or lie in wait for someone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An idiomatic use illustrated by اَللّٰهُ مِنْ وَرَائِكَ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A descendant beyond a person, specifically a grandchild or child's child.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A nominal genealogical use for offspring of a later generation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Humanity or the people inhabiting the earth at a given time.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The term excludes those who have already passed away and those who will be born later.
An adjectival description of meat as plump or fatty.
A figurative idiom based on a firebrand that produces fire, contrasting with a firebrand that fails to do so.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Move back, step aside, or make room.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A fixed exhortative expression with an implied verb; it is not simply a statement of location.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The revealed Book of Law associated with Moses.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A lexicalized noun for the scripture inherited from Moses.

cautions: وَرَاءَ is relational: depending on viewpoint and reference point, Quran translations may say behind, ahead, after, beyond, or on the other side; these are contextual realizations of the same lexical item.
